trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, awarded once every other trophy on the list has been earned. There is nothing separate to do for it: work through the story, strands, collectibles, activities and money trophies in the roadmap order and it unlocks last. Treat it as your final checklist confirmation rather than a task of its own.
steps: Audit the tracker stage by stage and write down every trophy still unearned
Work the stages in roadmap order — story, strands, collectibles and exploration, activities, then money and cleanup — instead of chasing trophies at random
Confirm 54 of 55 are ticked in the tracker; the platinum is then awarded automatically, with nothing separate left to complete
trophies.tip: Do not chase the platinum directly — it is a completion check on the other 54, so your real target is always the earliest unfinished stage.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The description requires all five takedowns inside one activation, so wait for a crowded fight rather than spending the ability on a lone enemy. As general strategy, let a group gather, trigger Combat Focus once, and work through the nearest targets first.
steps: Wait for a crowded fight: do not spend Combat Focus on one or two enemies
When at least five enemies are in reach, activate Combat Focus once
Take down 5 enemies inside that single activation — the counter tracks takedowns per attempt — and confirm the trophy unlocks
trophies.tip: Never spend Combat Focus on a small group — wait until five enemies are genuinely in reach of one activation.
sources: Official trophy description (PlayStation list via Exophase & PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape for this silver trophy. The description requires both halves each time: get into the vault, take the money, and then escape successfully, five times over. As general strategy, plan your exit before you start each robbery, and treat a failed escape as a robbery that does not count toward the five.
steps: Plan the exit before each robbery: know your escape route and vehicle before you enter the vault
Rob the bank vault, then escape cleanly — a robbery without the escape does not meet the description
Repeat and confirm the counter reaches 5 vaults robbed and escaped
trophies.tip: A vault robbery without the escape does not count — plan the getaway before you plan the robbery, every time.
